findings.claim: Several counter and EOF facts have no compiled assertion that would fail if they were omitted. That includes the new drain-site wiring of interrupted_read.
findings.evidence:
The only Interrupted test is unit_interrupted_read_result_is_pending_and_counter_saturates (diagnostic_tests.rs:589-601), which calls the helper directly. Deleting `s.interrupted_read()` at inspection.rs:268-270 fails no test.
Similarly, no test asserts a positive would_block count (260-264) or status.pending/interrupted counts (75-82). The invariants `calls > would_block+interrupted` (diagnostic_tests.rs:62) and `reads >= wb+int+eof` (inspection.rs:1196) still pass when an increment is removed.
Pending stderr is never asserted, although design:232-233 claims real fixtures cover pending stdout/stderr.
